items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: The waiter come over and said, "There's a party over there, Rock & White. They want to know if you know any music from the show."

ctx.x: And all the celebrities used to come there for dinner?

Yeah, after--we used to work from seven til twelve. The waiter come over and said, "There's a party over there, Rock & White. They want to know if you know any music from the show." I said, "see! I told you they'd be down here!" So I said, "Yes, I know 'Mississippi'."
So I sang it, or talked--it was a talk-song.... a lisp. (sings) "M-I-Sth-Sth-I-Sth-Sth-I-P-P-I, That used to be so hard to spell, it almost made me cry." And I sang the whole thing through.
